BiblicalUsage: Shomrah is watchfulness, and it appears once, in a prayer that has become my own: set a watch before my mouth, and keep the door of my lips. The psalmist does not ask for a guard on his house or his city but on his mouth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mouth needs a watchman as much as any gate, and I ask God to keep the door of my lips because my words go out before my thoughts catch up.
